ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with high-intensity (white) concentrations at distal regions; estimated 70:30 black-to-white pixel distribution across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white regions are concentrated at the distal tips of both lobes. Left tip contains three distinct horizontal white bands. Right tip features a broad, mottled white patch with irregular boundaries tapering toward the median hub.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped indentation; estimated interior angle of 115 degrees; bounding-box depth is approximately 7% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; more pronounced, jagged peaks (amplitude 5-12 pixels) visible on the right lobe edge compared to the left.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory from the central base tapering to sharp, slightly upward-curved distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Scattered circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (2-5 pixel radius) located in the lower-central black region and dispersed within the mottled white patch of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 parallel horizontal white linear streaks on the far-left distal tip; vertical white rake-like disruptions visible within the right-lobe pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Small irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately 40% distance from the median notch toward the tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast white horizontal 'dash' mark located in the lower-central black region near the peduncle water line.
